lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Honeyed Seed and Yogurt Bowls
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with sunflower seeds and honey
dishes.method: Spoon the yogurt into bowls, top with sunflower seeds and a drizzle of honey. For Odalric, serve with his own blackcurrant jam on the side.
dishes.why: A high-protein start to the day that requires no cooking, perfect for a busy Wednesday morning.

dishes.name: Sizzling Beef and Pepper Bowls
dishes.title: Beef and green pepper stir-fry with basmati rice
dishes.method: Serve the freshly cooked beef and pepper stir-fry over a bed of steamed rice. Add hot sauce for Casimir.
dishes.why: The loud green peppers provide a visual and textural anchor for this high-protein muscle-building lunch.

dishes.name: Golden Chicken and Broccoli Roast
dishes.title: Roast chicken thighs with broccoli and white potatoes
dishes.method: Plate the warm roasted chicken thighs alongside the broccoli and potatoes straight from the oven. Add hot sauce for Casimir.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner with a loud vegetable that satisfies the coach's requirement for a cooked evening meal.

dishes.name: Soft Scrambled Eggs on Toast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs on white toast
dishes.method: Whisk and scramble the eggs in a pan with butter. Serve on toasted bread, removing crusts for Wilfrid. Odalric has jam on his toast.
dishes.why: A warm breakfast with high-quality protein to fuel the day while the kitchen table is occupied.

dishes.name: Reheated Beef and Pepper Rice
dishes.title: Warm beef and pepper stir-fry with rice
dishes.method: Reheat a portion of the beef and rice in a pan with a splash of water until steaming. Serve in bowls. Add hot sauce for Casimir.
dishes.why: Easy to eat from a bowl while the hallway is being repainted and the kitchen table is covered.

dishes.name: Warm Roasted Chicken and Potatoes
dishes.title: Roasted chicken thighs with broccoli and potatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, broccoli, and potatoes in the oven at 180C for 15 minutes. Serve in bowls. Add hot sauce for Casimir.
dishes.why: A warm dinner that avoids the dust-covered table, providing a solid protein anchor for the evening.

dishes.name: Creamy Yogurt and Berry Bowl
dishes.title: Greek yogurt with frozen berries and seeds
dishes.method: Mix the yogurt with berries and seeds. Odalric adds his blackcurrant jam.
dishes.why: A refreshing, high-protein breakfast to start the final day of the stretch.

dishes.name: Final Chicken and Broccoli Bowl
dishes.title: Roast chicken and broccoli with potatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the remaining chicken, broccoli, and potatoes in a pan or oven. Add hot sauce for Casimir.
dishes.why: Finishing the batch of chicken and loud broccoli ensures no waste and high protein for lunch.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared White Fish and Beans
dishes.title: Seared cod fillets with steamed green beans and bread
dishes.method: Sear the cod in olive oil until flaky. Steam the green beans. Serve with a squeeze of lemon and bread (crusts off for Wilfrid).
dishes.why: A fresh fish dinner with loud green beans to end the stretch. White fish is used to respect Peregrine's colour preference.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs and broccoli
preparations.method: Toss chicken and broccoli florets in olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 200C for 35-40 minutes until chicken is golden and cooked through.

preparations.title: Beef and green pepper stir-fry
preparations.method: Slice peppers into strips. Stir-fry beef and peppers in a hot pan with oil until beef is browned and peppers are tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Boiled white potatoes
preparations.method: Peel and chop potatoes into chunks. Boil in salted water for 15-20 minutes until tender. Drain and cool.

preparations.title: Steamed basmati rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in double the volume of water for 10-12 minutes until fluffy. Drain and cool.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat oven for chicken and potatoes. Prep potatoes and broccoli. Get potatoes boiling and chicken/broccoli roasting. While they cook, start the rice. Prep peppers and beef, then stir-fry. Box the rice and beef first, then the chicken and potatoes once finished.
